title: What you need

text: ⌃ Android device that is new or factory-reset. USB cable. Recommended: Linux or Mac with the latest Chrome browser. Windows may require additional device drivers depending on the phone model.

title: Step 1 — Prepare the Android device
crumb: FieldX Documentation › Enroll Device › Web Based Enrolment
text: ⌄ 1. Unbox a new device or factory reset an existing device. 2. Power on the device. 3. Complete the Android Setup Wizard. 4. Do not add a Google account. 5. Do not install third-party apps or perform extra setup.

title: Step 2 — Enable USB debugging
crumb: FieldX Documentation › Enroll Device › Web Based Enrolment
text: ⌄ 1. Open Settings → About phone . 2. Tap Build number 7 times. 3. Open Developer options . 4. Turn on USB debugging and confirm the warning.

title: Step 3 — Prepare your computer
crumb: FieldX Documentation › Enroll Device › Web Based Enrolment
text: ⌄ Close Android Studio and other tools that use ADB before starting the Web Installer. The Web Installer needs exclusive access to the device. If an ADB server is running, stop it with adb kill-server .

title: Step 4 — Connect and enrol
crumb: FieldX Documentation › Enroll Device › Web Based Enrolment
text: ⌄ 1. Connect the Android device to your computer using USB. 2. Connect the device to Wi-Fi. 3. In Web Installer, select Connect your Device . 4. Follow the on-screen provisioning steps. 5. Wait while the FieldX EMM agent is installed and the device is provisioned.

title: Step 5 — Verify enrolment
crumb: FieldX Documentation › Enroll Device › Web Based Enrolment
text: ⌄ On the Android device, confirm that the FieldX EMM app/agent is installed. In the FieldX Admin Portal, confirm that the device appears as enrolled and that the required policies and profiles are applied.

Auto-discover: Select Scan for devices , choose the target, then select Connect when the connection port is available. Manual: Enter the target IP address and the ADB connect port shown…

text: ⌄ 1. Select Start setup . 2. Wait while provisioning runs. 3. Do not disconnect the device or close FieldX Installer. 4. When complete, the app displays “All done! FieldX is installed and this device is ready to use.” 5. Select Disconnect and check the target device.

crumb: FieldX Documentation › Enroll Device › Activation QR Code
text: ⌄ 1. Open the FieldX Android application. 2. Select Enrol Device . 3. Scan the Activation QR Code or enter the Access Code manually. 4. Complete the enrolment steps shown on the device.

title: When is Server URL required?
crumb: FieldX Documentation › Enroll Device › Activation QR Code
text: ⌄ The Server URL field is required only when connecting to a privately hosted MDM server.

title: Web Installer does not detect my device
crumb: FieldX Documentation › Enroll Device › Troubleshooting
text: ⌄ Confirm USB debugging is enabled. Try another USB cable or USB port. On Windows, make sure the correct device drivers are installed. Close Android Studio and other ADB tools. If required, run adb kill-server , reconnect the device, and retry.

title: FieldX Installer cannot find my device
crumb: FieldX Documentation › Enroll Device › Troubleshooting
text: ⌄ Make sure both phones are connected to the same Wi-Fi network. Confirm Wireless debugging is enabled on the target device. For pairing-code mode, keep the target's pairing screen open.

title: Wireless ADB disconnects during setup
crumb: FieldX Documentation › Enroll Device › Troubleshooting
text: ⌄ Return to the Connect step. Reconnect the target device. Return to Set up device. Select Start setup again.

title: Setup says the device is not ready
crumb: FieldX Documentation › Enroll Device › Troubleshooting
text: ⌄ Make sure the target device has no signed-in accounts. Make sure no other device-management app is installed. If necessary, factory reset the device and repeat the preparation steps.
